channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Parcel C2
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Parcel C2 (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel C2: Parcel C2 showed 2042 as an expected completion. That year is the original deadline for the whole project's last phase, not a forecast for C2, so it was removed.
item.description: Parcel C2 showed 2042 as an expected completion. That year is the original deadline for the whole project's last phase, not a forecast for C2, so it was removed. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel C2: The Phase 1 schedule is described as tolled by the down market delay (extended to December 26, 2026, Port Item 11A) rather than lapsed, with the 2042 whole-project date kept as a soft date that is not a forecast for this parcel. The map notes no longer say the block has no Assessor lot or that the D4D height figure shows a Residential fill; Residential use is cited to D4D Figure 2.1.1 (which also allows a garage) and the 100% affordable C2A status to Port Resolution 20-07. The Chinatown CDC page is described as not naming a parcel; 'since 2022' was dropped from the Port's statement; the Brookfield construction halt is dated 2022 rather than April 2022; the Board of Supervisors vote on the Development Agreement shows first reading Oct 31 and final passage Nov 14, 2017; and the Aug 11, 2026 Port Commission minutes now back the informational hearing.
item.description: The Phase 1 schedule is described as tolled by the down market delay (extended to December 26, 2026, Port Item 11A) rather than lapsed, with the 2042 whole-project date kept as a soft date that is not a forecast for this parcel. The map notes no longer say the block has no Assessor lot or that the D4D height figure shows a Residential fill; Residential use is cited to D4D Figure 2.1.1 (which also allows a garage) and the 100% affordable C2A status to Port Resolution 20-07. Source: Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 Special Use District Design for Development, updated 2022-04-26 (https://www.sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline=); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 12B and Resolution 20-07, 2020-02-11 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%2012B%20Pier%2070%20Parcels%20E2%20and%20A.pdf); San Francisco Board of Supervisors, Ordinance No. 224-17 (https://sfbos.org/sites/default/files/o0224-17.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2026-08-11 (https://www.sfport.com/media/11558/download?inline).

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel C2: Port Commission hears an informational report (staff report dated Aug 7; no action taken) on proposed DDA amendments: parcel-specific outside dates, a Project-wide affordable rate of no less than 20% (327 stand-alone affordable units kept), 65-to-90 ft height increases on certain residential parcels, developer return cut from 18% to 14%, and a new phasing plan (Aug 11, 2026)
item.description: Port Commission hears an informational report (staff report dated Aug 7; no action taken) on proposed DDA amendments: parcel-specific outside dates, a Project-wide affordable rate of no less than 20% (327 stand-alone affordable units kept), 65-to-90 ft height increases on certain residential parcels, developer return cut from 18% to 14%, and a new phasing plan (Aug 11, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel C2: Port staff report for the Commission's Aug 11, 2026 meeting (dated Aug 7) says the C2A affordable project 'has not advanced' for lack of gap funding; proposed amendments would require the developer to close escrow on C2B (with A and D) by 2029-2030 or face a public offering (Aug 11, 2026)
item.description: Port staff report for the Commission's Aug 11, 2026 meeting (dated Aug 7) says the C2A affordable project 'has not advanced' for lack of gap funding; proposed amendments would require the developer to close escrow on C2B (with A and D) by 2029-2030 or face a public offering (Aug 11, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.

item.title: Planned · Pier 70 Parcel C2: Port reports that although Phase 1 horizontal infrastructure and Building 12's rehabilitation are complete, construction of Phase 1 vertical buildings and parks 'has not moved forward' because of pandemic-driven office-vacancy increases, 20-30% construction-cost escalation and higher financing costs (Aug 7, 2026)
item.description: Port reports that although Phase 1 horizontal infrastructure and Building 12's rehabilitation are complete, construction of Phase 1 vertical buildings and parks 'has not moved forward' because of pandemic-driven office-vacancy increases, 20-30% construction-cost escalation and higher financing costs (Aug 7, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.
